HANS KOHLER AG, Switzerland's number one stainless steel supplier, faced a critical digital transformation challenge. Their existing commerce platform was severely outdated, slow, and heavily dependent on manual processes. Customers were still placing orders via phone, email, and even fax, creating inefficiencies throughout the organization.

The transformation delivered immediate operational improvements and customer satisfaction gains. Daily orders increased by 15-20% as customers migrated from phone and email ordering to the intuitive self-service platform. The seamless ERP integration eliminated manual data entry, reducing errors and freeing internal resources for higher-value activities.

Most ecommerce platforms model a customer as one person with one email address and one card. Your customer is a business. It has several buyers, a purchasing manager who signs off above a limit, a price agreed last year, and a finance team that pays on invoice thirty days later.

Traditional in-flight retail was declining rapidly. Airlines struggled with the logistical nightmare of managing physical inventory, while passengers found paper catalogs uninspiring and limited to 300-500 basic items. The industry needed a complete transformation to turn in-flight retail from a cost center into a profitable revenue stream.

SKYdeals recognized this opportunity and set out to create "shoppertainment" – combining shopping with entertainment during flights. However, building a digital marketplace for the aviation industry presented unique challenges: unreliable in-flight connectivity, complex integrations with diverse airline systems, and the need for rapid deployment across multiple carriers.

Our multi-channel system proved crucial for airline adoption. Each carrier received their own branded storefront while sharing a unified backend, dramatically reducing complexity and maintenance overhead. The team also optimized our asset management capabilities for low-bandwidth environments, ensuring smooth performance even at 35,000 feet.

SKYdeals demonstrates how headless commerce enables innovation in specialized industries. By choosing a flexible, API-driven foundation, they transformed a declining market segment while creating new revenue opportunities for airlines and brands alike.
